Find the renegades who hold Jabba's son, your mission will be, Skywalker.|Master Yoda informs Obi-Wan Kenobi, Anakin Skywalker, and Ahsoka Tano of their new mission|audio=Kidnapped-TCWf.flac|}} The '''Battle of Teth''' took place in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teth/Legends|Teth]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Seeking to gain safe passage through [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and the Confederacy kidnapped [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]], son of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], intending to frame the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for the crime. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his recently apprenticed [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], were assigned to retrieve Rotta in order to win the crime lord's favor for safe passage through Hutt Space. Skywalker and Tano ventured to the [[B'omarr Order/Legends|B'omarr Order]] [[B'omarr Monastery|Monastery]] on Teth—where Republic [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] had located the Huttlet—with [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]], while [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] [[Hutt–Republic treaty/Legends|negotiated]] with Jabba on the crime lord's [[Homeworld/Legends|home planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Unable to land at the Teth monastery because of the presence of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] guarding it, Skywalker and Tano deployed their forces in the jungle below and commenced a vertical assault up the cliff holding the monastery using two [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE walkers]]. After Skywalker and Tano had defeated the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and retrieved the Huttlet, [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] led several more Confederate units on a renewed assault of the monastery, and the Republic forces were forced to barricade themselves inside the stronghold. The two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] went to find a secondary exit to escape the monastery, hoping to find medical support for the Huttlet, while [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]], nicknamed "Rex," stayed to command Torrent Company. Ventress and her forces managed to enter the monastery, and all but six [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]], the last six—including Rex—being taken [[Prisoner/Legends|captive]]. With the help of the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], Skywalker and Tano located a rear exit in the monastery and [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|confronted]] Ventress herself before escaping Teth in an [[Twilight/Legends|old freighter]]. However, the Jedi were forced to continue directly to Tatooine in the [[Starship/Legends|ship]], as the main [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] of the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Spirit of the Republic]]'' was severely damaged by Confederate [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]], preventing them from boarding. Meanwhile, Kenobi arrived on Teth with reinforcements, in the form of the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]] and several [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]]. Kenobi also dueled with Ventress, and the Dark Acolyte escaped after she discovered that Skywalker had left the [[Teth system/Legends|system]] for Tatooine. With the reinforcements, the Republic forces were able to defeat the Confederacy. ==Prelude== {{Quote|Could you kill a child?''"
"''Could ''you''?|Ziro Desilijic Tiure and Count Dooku|}} In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] sought access to the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|lanes]] passing through [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]-controlled [[Hutt Space/Legends|space]]. Seven [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] into the war, the Confederacy developed a plan to capture [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]], the son of Hutt [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], and received secret assistance from Jabba's uncle, [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]]. The Confederacy sought to frame the Republic and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for the crime and return Jabba's son to him themselves, planning to win the crime lord's favor as well as access to the hyperspace lanes. Ziro himself sought to take Jabba's place as leader of the Hutt clans. Once the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had recovered Rotta, the Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]], [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], planned to use a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], [[4A-7/Legends|4A-7]], to record a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of Rotta in the Jedi's possession, and Dooku would be able to deceive Jabba into granting the Confederacy access through Hutt Space with the recording. The Jedi and the Republic would then punish Jabba severely for his crimes. [[File:Octopus_ship_capture.png|thumb|left|240px|The [[Trident (starship)/Legends|''Trident'']] captures the [[Khetanna/Legends|sail barge]] carrying Rotta.]] The [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] kidnapped Jabba's son on his [[Homeworld/Legends|home planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], spiriting him away to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teth/Legends|Teth]]—specifically to a [[B'omarr Order/Legends|B'omarr Order]] [[B'omarr Monastery|Monastery]] that Ziro had previously seized.{{FactFile2014|19|TET 1-2|Teth}} Unaware of the involvement of both the Confederacy and his uncle in the situation, Jabba employed [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to find Rotta, in addition to requesting the help of the Republic and the Jedi Order. However, the only Jedi who could be spared for the mission were [[High Jedi General/Legends|High General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who were at the time [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|battling]] Confederate forces on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]]. The [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunters hired by Jabba tracked Rotta to the Teth monastery. However, they were captured and decapitated, and their heads were sent back to Jabba. Republic [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|Advanced Recon Force trooper]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] also tracked the Huttlet to Teth, and upon the conclusion of the Battle of Christophsis, Kenobi left to [[Hutt–Republic treaty/Legends|negotiate]] with Jabba on Tatooine on the Republic's behalf. The Jedi were given only one planetary rotation by the crime lord to retrieve his son and apprehend his captors; furthermore, if the Republic and the Jedi could not complete the task, the mission would be given to [[Count/Legends|Count]] Dooku and the Confederacy. Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] charged Skywalker and his newly apprenticed [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] learner, [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], with rescuing Jabba's son, and following the scouts' reports, Skywalker and Tano ventured to Teth. However, the Jedi were also unaware of the Confederacy's role in Rotta's capture. Skywalker and Tano arrived over Teth aboard an [[Anakin Skywalker's Acclamator-class assault ship (Teth)/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] with a unit of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and rendezvoused with the Republic scouts. The ARF [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] reported that the monastery was being guarded by at least two [[Battalion/Legends|battalions]] of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. Furthermore, the monastery was heavily fortified, and the Republic forces would not be able to land there. Skywalker elected to commence with a ground assault, and the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|assault ship]] descended into Teth's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. The [[Transport/Legends|transport]] deployed several [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]] with the Jedi and [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]] aboard, in addition to several [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/carrier/Legends|LAAT/carriers]] bringing two [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE walkers]]. The [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] transporting Skywalker, Tano, and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]], nicknamed "Rex," was [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|Clone Lieutenant]] [[Hawk/Legends|Hawk]]. ==The battle== ===Vertical assault=== {{Quote|So, this is where the fun begins.''"
"''Race you to the top.''"
"''I'll give you a head start.''"
"''Your mistake.|Ahsoka Tano and Anakin Skywalker|audio=RaceYouToTheTop-TCWf.flac|}} As the Republic gunships approached the monastery, the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] spotted them and opened fire. Closing their [[Blast shield/Legends|blast shields]], the gunships were able to safely land, and the Republic forces approached the cliff. The droid forces, under the command of an [[Unidentified OOM command battle droid (Teth)/Legends|OOM command battle droid]], soon sighted Tano and concentrated fire at her; the Republic forces responded by opening fire on the droids with the AT-TE [[Walker/Legends|walkers]]. In the resulting exchange of [[Laser/Legends|laser]] fire, the Jedi and the [[Troop/Legends|troopers]] were able to reach the foot of the monastery mesa, taking cover in an overhang. The Jedi and [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] used vines to ascend the half-mile cliff, and the clone troopers also used the [[Grappling hook/Legends|grappling hooks]] in their [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]], while the two AT-TE walkers used the claws in their footpads to maintain a strong hold on the vertical face. As Skywalker and his troops were ascending the cliff, battle droids launched a ground attack from the rear, but clone troopers on [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeders]] provided mobile combat support and defended the Jedi's assault team. Several [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|DSD1 dwarf spider droids]] concentrated fire at the climbing AT-TE walkers, breaking one's grip on the cliffside and sending it off the face. Tano defended the remaining walker by jumping onto its windscreen and rebounding the droid fire. [[File:ATTE_scale_cliff.png|thumb|right|250px|The Republic troops and the AT-TE scale the cliff.]] The Republic forces were attacked by several [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] on [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Platforms]], and the two front legs of Tano's walker lost their grip. Noticing the reeling walker, Skywalker immediately jumped down from above and eliminated the droid pilots by leaping from one STAP to the next, kicking them off one by one, and claiming the last STAP for himself. Ascending the cliff once more, Skywalker used his STAP to eliminate several dwarf spider droids, clearing a path for Rex and Torrent Company,[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (junior novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' junior novelization]] while the AT-TE walker regained its purchase on the cliff face. Skywalker's STAP was shot down just short of the landing pad entrance to the monastery. The Jedi managed to leap the remaining distance and destroyed the remaining droids in front of the monastery. Skywalker was assailed by several [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] deployed from inside the stronghold, but the arrival of Tano and the AT-TE walker stopped the destroyer droids before they could fire a single shot. The monastery was secured; however, Skywalker and Tano had lost over half their men during the ascent. After a moment of planning with Rex, Skywalker and Tano entered the monastery and encountered 4A-7, the Confederate [[Spy/Legends|spy]] droid who had been assigned to gather evidence of Rotta in the Jedi's possession. The droid claimed to be the caretaker of the monastery and told them that the droids kept their [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] in the lower levels. Ordering Rex and his men to stay at the entrance, the Jedi ventured deeper into the monastery to retrieve the Huttlet. Ventress and her droids were waiting, concealed elsewhere in the monastery exterior. The Dark Acolyte prepared to collect the data that her master—[[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] Count Dooku—needed to frame the Jedi. Skywalker and Tano entered the dungeons and were assailed by several battle droids. Tano eliminated most of them before the two Jedi located the captured Huttlet. However, the Jedi realized that Rotta was sick and required medical attention; the Confederacy had deliberately infected Rotta with a bacterial infection, intending to make it harder for Rotta to be returned to his father alive. Upon their return to the courtyard exterior, the Jedi placed Rotta in a [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]] for easier transport, despite the Huttlet's resistance. However, they were unaware that their actions were being recorded by 4A-7. The spy droid's [[holograph]]ic recording was transmitted to Dooku, who showed it to Jabba as proof that his son was in possession of the Jedi and was being inhumanely treated by them. The ruse was successful, and Dooku was able to fool Jabba into believing his deception. Ventress was given a new objective—to recover the Huttlet alive so that he could be delivered to Jabba on the Confederacy's behalf. ===Confederacy counter-assault=== {{Quote|Mistress, the Jedi have barricaded themselves inside the main vault.''"
"''They have nowhere to run.|A B1 battle droid reports to Asajj Ventress|audio=NowhereToRun-TCWf.flac|}} Through a holotransmission broadcast through the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], Skywalker and Tano delivered a status report to Kenobi. The Jedi suspected the Confederacy's involvement in Rotta's abduction and also deduced that the Confederacy was using them to convince Jabba—and by extension, the Hutt clans—to join their struggle against the Republic. Before the conference could continue, however, several Confederate [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing crafts]] approached the monastery, deploying [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|vulture droids]] to attack the Republic forces. As several [[Squad/Legends|squads]] of battle droids approached on foot, the Republic [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]] attempted to hold its position. The remaining AT-TE walker defended the monastery entrance with [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeants]] [[Coric]] and [[Hez]] and their squads, while the rest of the Republic forces took cover in the building. [[File:Confederate_counterassault.png|thumb|left|250px|Confederate droids swarm the monastery.]] The AT-TE walker fell to droid fire, and the Jedi and the clones were forced back into the monastery, barricading themselves inside the stronghold. However, the defense of the monastery caused Skywalker to loose three-quarters of his men. The droids set up a cordon and worked to hack the door controls. As Rotta still required medical attention, Tano convinced Skywalker to look for an escape to find assistance for the Huttlet, while Rex stayed to hold position and command the forces. The Jedi came upon an old Hutt throne room, and R2-D2 analyzed the building schematics from a link to the monastery's systems. Too impatient to wait for the battle droids to hack through the lock, Ventress sliced through the door's controls with one of her lightsabers, causing it to open from a safety mechanism. B1 and [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 battle droids]] surged forward with dwarf spider droids following close behind, and Torrent Company was soon overwhelmed, with only six clone troopers—including Captain Rex—surviving the assault. Ventress ordered the droids to seal all exits, but she was suddenly attacked by Rex, who had been feigning [[Death/Legends|death]]. The clone captain destroyed an [[Unidentified OOM command battle droid 2 (Teth)/Legends|OOM command battle droid]] next to the Dark Acolyte, but Ventress deflected the clone's [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire and [[Telekinesis/Legends|pulled]] his blaster out of his hand with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Force-choking Rex, Ventress demanded Skywalker's location from the clone but received only defiance in response. Ventress attempted to perform a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] on Rex, but the trooper was able to resist her influence and secretly alerted Skywalker to the Dark Acolyte's presence via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]]. After Ventress had left to find the Jedi, Rex and the other five Torrent Company survivors were taken captive and put under battle droid guard. ===Pit fight=== {{Quote|Ventress.''"
"''Dooku's assassin?''"
"''She's here to kill the Hutt. Come on.|Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano receive Rex's bogus communication|audio=HereToKillTheHutt-TCWf.flac|}} When Rex contacted Skywalker, he addressed him as "Anakin" instead of his usual "General Skywalker," alerting the Jedi that the Dark Acolyte was in the monastery. R2-D2 was able to find an exterior landing pad at the rear of the monastery, and the Jedi headed toward the exit. However, before they could get far, Ventress arrived with several B2 super battle droids. Surrounded, Skywalker exchanged banter with the Dark Acolyte before R2-D2 suddenly activated a trap door in the floor, sending all of them plunging down a long chute. Skywalker, Tano, Ventress, and the droids landed in a large, round room, and Skywalker immediately [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|engaged]] Ventress while Tano dealt with the droids. [[File:Pit_duel_Teth.png|thumb|right|250px|Ventress duels the Jedi in the rancor pit.]] Skywalker managed to deprive Ventress of one of her lightsabers, only to be knocked down and disarmed himself. Ventress was soon confronted by Tano, who had eliminated the droids. The Dark Acolyte reclaimed her second lightsaber and turned to engage the Padawan, and Skywalker rejoined the fight. As Ventress saberlocked with the Jedi and called on the Force to strengthen herself, Skywalker ordered Tano to escape with Rotta. However, as Tano opened a large door on the side of the room on her way out, she accidentally set loose a captive [[Jungle rancor/Legends|jungle rancor]]. Skywalker and Ventress leaped onto the creature's back and continued their duel, and the creature rounded on Tano and the Huttlet. Seeing this, Skywalker slashed at the rancor's back, causing it to violently buck. A number of battle droids entered the overhead gallery and opened fire on Skywalker as he continued to duel Ventress, but the battle droids above were assailed by R2-D2, who pushed them into the arena below. Tano attacked the [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]], stabbing it in the foot, and the rancor threw off the two duelists on its back. The creature rounded on Tano; however, as it leaned toward her, Tano brought up her lightsaber and drove her weapon into its nose. The rancor fell back in pain, right onto Ventress, and with the Dark Acolyte distracted, the Jedi were able to escape. As Ventress ignited her lightsaber into the rancor's rear, the creature reared up and clung to the ceiling, allowing the Dark Acolyte to escape. ===Republic reinforcements=== {{Quote|Surrender, Republic dogs!''"
"''We've got you outnumbered!''"
"''''Outnumbered?'' Wait. One, two, three—|A B1 battle droid and Captain Rex, shortly before the droids are attacked by Obi-Wan Kenobi's starfighter|audio=Outnumbered-TCWf.flac|}} As Ventress renewed her pursuit of the Jedi, she received word that Republic reinforcements had arrived, in the form of the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Spirit of the Republic]]'' under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]]. Kenobi, who was aboard the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], led several [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]] in [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|his Delta-7B fighter]]. In response, Ventress ordered an [[Unidentified OOM command battle droid 3 (Teth)/Legends|OOM command battle droid]] to launch all of their vulture droids. Kenobi's [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] approached the monastery, and the Jedi and his forces engaged the droid fighters. Meanwhile, Skywalker, Tano, and R2-D2 arrived at the monastery's rear landing pad and signaled an LAAT/i gunship for an extraction. The gunship arrived and hovered near the platform, but before the Jedi and Rotta could board the craft, a Confederate vulture droid swooped in and destroyed the gunship. The vulture droid landed on the platform, and Skywalker and Tano engaged it in combat before severing its legs and sending it off the platform. [[File:Battle_of_Teth_1.png|thumb|left|250px|Torrent Company uses a fallen AT-TE for cover.]] Skywalker attempted to contact Kenobi for backup but found that the Confederacy was [[Jammer/Legends|jamming]] their transmissions. Meanwhile, the remaining six captives of Torrent Company broke free of their battle droid guards, stealing some of the droids' blasters for themselves. The clones used the fallen AT-TE for cover and engaged the battle droids in a [[Lightfight|crossfire]], and the troopers even went so far as to plant [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] within an eviscerated super battle droid. The droid was sent back into the Confederate lines, and the explosives planted inside of it were remotely detonated, destroying many of the droid's unsuspecting comrades. However, the battle droids returned to converge on the clones. After receiving a status report from Rex, Skywalker prepared to head back to help the clones, while Tano believed that they needed to search for a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to deliver Rotta back to Tatooine alive. Before they could escape, Skywalker and Tano found themselves confronted by a pair of droidekas with Ventress following close behind. R2-D2 quickly closed the landing pad door, and Ventress immediately began to cut through the door with her lightsabers. Skywalker prepared to retreat into the jungle, but the appearance of two dwarf spider droids stopped him. The droids began to climb up the cliff under the platform and fired at the platform's supports, upsetting several [[Can-cell/Legends|can-cells]] that were nesting under the platform. Skywalker and Tano believed that they were out of options, but Rotta alerted them to the presence of another landing pad on a nearby mesa, with an [[Twilight/Legends|old freighter]] docked on it. Skywalker jumped on a can-cell, [[Animal bond|commandeering]] it with the Force''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Who Are the Jedi?]]'' and intending on using it to get to the nearby platform. Ventress was able to cut through the door and engaged Tano in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]], and after several blows were exchanged, the young Jedi was driven to the ground. As Ventress demanded Skywalker's location, Skywalker himself appeared, having successfully gained control of the can-cell. The Jedi attacked the Dark Acolyte with the beast, knocking her backward. As the droids' fire destroyed the platform's supports, Tano and her master flew over to the other mesa on the can-cell with R2-D2 following with his booster jets. Unable to pursue, Ventress was told by a battle droid that Dooku demanded a status report. The Dark Acolyte took her frustration out on the droid by seizing it with the Force and hurling it off the platform, and she reentered the monastery. 4A-7, who was preparing to leave on the old [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], detected the approaching Jedi and contacted Ventress; the spy droid resolved to delay the Jedi. When the two Jedi reached the secondary landing platform, they encountered 4A-7, but the spy droid was given away by the presence of battle droids. Tano eliminated the droids before decapitating 4A-7. Still fighting the [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] above, Kenobi and his squadron noticed Torrent Company's engagement of the droids on the east side of the monastery and headed over to help them. [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Marshal Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|CC-2224]], nicknamed "Cody," deployed several LAAT/i gunships from the ''Spirit of the Republic''—containing troops from the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]]—to give aid to Torrent Company. [[File:Sky_fight_over_Teth.png|thumb|right|250px|Skywalker's freighter heads toward the ''Spirit of the Republic''.]] Rex and Torrent Company managed to defeat an approaching vulture droid and surged forward, using the fallen droid starfighter for cover. As Kenobi's fighter flew over the monastery, he ordered his astromech droid, [[R4-P17/Legends|R4-P17]], to take control of the fighter. The droids surrounded Torrent Company, but Kenobi fired at them before jumping out of his fighter and joining the Torrent Company survivors. Cody and the reinforcements arrived, and while the gunships ravaged the Confederate C-9979 landing craft, the clone trooper reinforcements were deployed to assist Torrent Company. Kenobi left to search for Skywalker in the monastery while the clones engaged the droids. Skywalker and Tano headed in the freighter toward the courtyard to reinforce Rex and his men. However, Tano convinced Skywalker of the importance to keep the Huttlet alive and safe. Skywalker reluctantly informed Rex that they would be unable to help him, and the Jedi headed to rendezvous with the ''Spirit of the Republic''. However, as they approached the Star Destroyer, the freighter was harassed by several Vulture droids and the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] itself, which believed the freighter to be an enemy ship. After receiving clearance from Yularen aboard the Star Destroyer, Skywalker attempted to land the ship on board the rear [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] of the cruiser. However, the Vulture droids forged past the ship and destroyed the hangar before the Jedi could land, forcing Skywalker to take the freighter directly to Tatooine, and Tano emptied the contents of the cargo hold before the ship jumped to hyperspace. ===Kenobi vs. Ventress=== {{Quote|Master Kenobi. Always chasing after Skywalker. How ''predictable''.''"
"''Anakin leaves quite a mess. Which always leads me to ''you'', Ventress.|Asajj Ventress and Obi-Wan Kenobi|audio=QuiteAMess-TCWf.flac|}} Upon entering the monastery, Kenobi encountered Ventress, who left her two super battle droid [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] to fight Kenobi, using the time it took the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] to defeat the droids to flee. Kenobi followed Ventress into another room, and the Dark Acolyte appeared from above and attacked Kenobi. As the two exchanged lightsaber blows, Ventress pulled off her skirt and flung it at Kenobi, taking advantage of his momentarily blocked sight to lunge at him. However, Kenobi was able to block her oncoming blows. When Ventress disarmed Kenobi and drove a lightsaber toward his throat, the Jedi Master ducked, and after taking hold of her wrists, he was able to drive her backward. Kenobi called his lightsaber back into his hand and continued the duel. [[File:Obi-Wan_vs_Ventress_Teth.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Obi-Wan Kenobi duels Asajj Ventress.]] Backing Kenobi against a pillar, Ventress lunged forward, but Kenobi ducked, and Ventress slashed the pillar instead of her intended target. After bladelocking with the Dark Acolyte, Kenobi Force-pushed Ventress backward. Continuing the duel, Ventress charged at Kenobi, and the Jedi Master used two pillars to [[Force jump/Legends|jump]] onto an upper platform on the side of the room. Ventress followed, and Kenobi affirmed to Ventress that the Confederacy's plan to turn the Hutts against the Jedi would not succeed. Ventress retorted that the plan would be effective when the truth died with him, and the Dark Acolyte dragged her lightsabers across the platform as she leaped into the air and unleashed a series of overhand attacks. Kenobi was able to block the blows and countered a powerful downward slash from the Dark Acolyte. Kenobi pushed his adversary backward, and Ventress joined her lightsabers to form a [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|saberstaff]]. Kenobi leaped through a [[Window/Legends|window]] to an external rampart of the monastery, and Ventress immediately gave pursuit. However, as Skywalker's freighter made the jump to hyperspace, both Ventress and Kenobi [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] Skywalker's departure. Enraged, Ventress continued to drive Kenobi backward, but Kenobi was able to disconnect his adversary's saberstaff. Kenobi blocked the Dark Acolyte's lightsabers and pushed them against the sides of the platform, flicking one out of her hand and into the jungle below. Deprived of one of her weapons, Ventress summoned a vulture droid for an escape before continuing the duel. Kenobi forced Ventress backward, but as he ordered her to surrender, the summoned vulture droid suddenly approached. Ventress escaped aboard the droid starfighter, and Kenobi returned to the courtyard, rejoining the fight. Without Ventress to lead them, and with their troop ships destroyed, the remaining droids were defeated by the Republic forces. ==Aftermath== ===Returning Rotta home=== {{Quote|The Republic had too many clone troopers, my lord. By the time we were able to find Jabba's son, Skywalker had already ''killed him''.|Asajj Ventress supports Count Dooku's lies|audio=SkywalkerAlreadyKilledHim-TCWf.flac|}} [[File:Ziro_the_Hutt.png|thumb|right|250px|Ziro conspires with Count Dooku via hologram.]] Much of the monastery was left damaged from the intense battle that had raged across it. Ventress sent a ship in pursuit of Skywalker's freighter, but she recalled it on Dooku's order. To assist the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] in his deception of Jabba, Ventress piloted the vulture droid back to the monastery and reported via hologram to Dooku and Jabba that the Republic had killed Rotta, enraging Jabba further. Although displeased with Ventress's failure, Dooku used the situation to his advantage by convincing Jabba that the Jedi were coming to Tatooine to eradicate the Hutt clans and the crime lord himself, and that they sought to gain complete control of Hutt Space without Jabba's interference. To please Jabba, Dooku intended to confront Skywalker himself using several [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]]. With the help of a hologram of a [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B]] [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] and medical supplements, Rotta was saved from near death onboard Skywalker's freighter. Skywalker and Tano arrived over Tatooine, preparing to land and return Rotta to his father. Several MagnaGuard-flown [[Rogue-class Porax-38 starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] attacked the freighter, and the Jedi [[Mission to Jabba's Palace (Clone Wars)/Legends|engaged]] the droid fighters. Meanwhile, on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] received word from [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of Jabba's erroneous beliefs of the role of the Jedi and the Republic in his son's kidnapping. Amidala sought to reopen communications between Jabba and the Republic and decided to enlist the help of the crime lord's uncle, Ziro Desilijic Tiure. The senator headed to [[Ziro's Palace/Legends|Ziro's Palace]], unaware of Ziro's allegiance with Dooku and the Confederacy. ===Political fallout=== Ultimately, Teth was removed from direct Hutt control, with the Republic expelling longstanding criminal activity out of the entire [[Teth system/Legends|system]].[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] The sudden nature of the beginning of the Battle of Teth, combined with other engagements like it throughout the Outer Rim, allowed Palpatine to implement a number of new security measures on his homeworld [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Senator Amidala had wanted to discuss those measures with Palpatine before learning of the danger Skywalker was faced with thanks to the Battle of Teth and changed her focus to help with the Hutt treaty. ==Behind the scenes== The Battle of Teth appeared in the [[2008]] [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] and also appeared in the film's [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|novelization]] and [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (junior novelization)|junior novelization]], as well as the young-reader's book [[The Clone Wars: Battle at Teth|''Battle at Teth'']]. The events of Rotta the Huttlet's capture were originally a [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)#Production|three-episode story arc]] in the 2008 [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television series']] [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]],{{JCFCite|url=posts/29437817|board=Live Action, Clone Wars & Classics|thread=The Clone Wars- Episode 106: Downfall of a Droid Discussion Thread (Spoilers Allowed)|user=[[Pablo Hidalgo|Pabawan]]|date=2008-11-11|time=6:23 PM|archivedate=20160427093053}} but after producer [[George Lucas]] decided to debut the series with a theatrical release, the episodes were combined with another first-season episode entitled "The New Padawan" to form ''The Clone Wars'' film.{{DB|location|christophsis|Christophsis}} Both of the duels that occurred during the battle were featured in the 2008 [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Lightsaber Duels]]''.''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Lightsaber Duels]]'' [[File:Asajj_vs_Anakin_Teth.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The duel in the rancor pit, one of the deleted scenes from the film]] Three notable parts of the battle were cut from the final movie, despite being shown in the promotional material for the film: the duel in the monastery rancor pit, Skywalker and Tano's fight with the Vulture droid on the monastery's outer platform, and Tano's emptying of the ''Twilight''{{'s}} cargo hold. Director [[Dave Filoni]] later commented that he removed the rancor sequence because rancors were already common in [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] stories, such as [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed|''The Force Unleashed'' video game]], and he had wanted to tell new stories that "feel" like ''[[Star Wars]]'' without repeating the original ''Star Wars'' itself.{{JCFCite|url=threads/29628723|board=Live Action, Clone Wars & Classics|thread=TheForce.Net interviews Henry Gilroy... and Dave Filoni !!! (Your questions answered!)|archivedate=20170207114253}} All three scenes were included in the "Deleted Scenes" feature of the film's [[Star Wars home video releases#Star Wars: The Clone Wars film|DVD release]].[[Star Wars home video releases#Star Wars: The Clone Wars film|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] The duel did not appear in the adult novelization or the film; however, it was described in the junior novelization, the young-reader's book [[The Clone Wars: Anakin in Action!|''Anakin in Action!'']],''[[The Clone Wars: Anakin in Action!]]'' and the reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'', which made the duel part of the [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] continuity. The fight with the Vulture droid and the emptying of the ''Twilight''{{'s}} cargo hold also happened in the adult novelization of the film, making them [[canon]]ical within Legends as well. The battle droids encountered by Republic forces on Teth were originally supposed to bear purple markings, similar to those stationed in Ziro's Palace. Because the droids would not be typical droid-army models, it was intended to hint that Ziro was behind the kidnapping of Rotta. However, the regular battle droid models were used during the film's animation process.{{DHBoards|url=viewtopic.php?p=222198&sid=7496c3847834915cbe5359f332fa6225#p222198|thread=''The Clone Wars'' TV SHOW on Cartoon Network: WOW [spoilers?]|user=Henry Gilroy|date=2009-03-15|nobackup=1}} The 2009 book ''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure]]'' expanded upon the Battle of Teth, from an appearance by Jedi Master [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] to a more prominent role for Asajj Ventress. However, because of the book's composition as a [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny|''Decide Your Destiny'']] installment without a definitive path, no single storyline in the book can be
